product_description: Columbia 36" 180-Grip Bent Box Handle allows for a full braking capability over the entire 180º angle span. Grips the axle with a tremendous amount of pressure to eliminates the possibility of slippage when dealing with difficult angle situations. As a result, this produces cleaner, quicker and more efficient application of joint compound. A very versatile design that provides the best possible braking at any angle. The bent handle design adds necessary leverage in all situations, and truly excels on butt-joints and headers.  Extra strong billet aluminum design for years of rugged usage. Less moving parts mean less breakdowns. Everything you want in a box handle. Bent handle ergonomics combined with a standard 3/4" tube - helps you achieve the perfect balance, and perfect finish with less effort. Features: Bent ergonomic design increases leverage and requires less effort to push Clamp style 180 brake is simple and more durable than pinch brakes Strong billet aluminum design with black anodizing, and laser engraving Additional braking, control, and range of motion versus competitor handles Compatible with all leading brand boxes (Excluding TapeWorm). 36" 180-Grip Bent Box Handle is ideal for wall work, butt joints, and ceilings

product_name: Columbia Sawed Off Mini PREDATOR Automatic Taper
product_description: Columbia Taping Tools introduces the world's first Mini Carbon Fiber Taper, The Predator "Sawed Off" Mini. Unlike other taper bodies made mostly from aluminum, the Predator's Carbon Fiber construction, makes this precision-engineered tool 20% lighter and more durable then any standard mini taper on the market. Another unique benefit of this Dent Proof construction, is that Carbon Fiber maintains temperature stability, meaning this taper will remain warm to the touch. The 6 wheel cutting sleeve has been updated in favor of teflon sliders which gives the operator a smoother glide and better grip. Now, changing the sliders out is simple field maintenance and can be installed with a standard screwdriver in minutes as opposed to half an hour or more. The pull ring is ideal for higher ceilings. The Predator will tape flats and angles effortlessly with less drag in the corners. The quick release cap makes cleaning a breeze and the stainless steel side plates, cable drum, and creaser arms offer a lifetime of corrosion resistance. With style, functionality, and durability the Predator from Columbia takes the -Evolution of Taping- to a whole new level. Predator "Sawed Off" Mini is perfect for taping drywall in small rooms and closets when a full size taper is too cumbersome. Features: Handmade From Carbon Fiber and Steel Components. Titanium Pull Rod. Adjustable Brake. Quick Release For Easy Tape Changing. Zero Drag System For Corners. Knurled Sleeve With Pull Ring. Stainless Steel Side Plates, Creaser Arms And Cable Drum. Quick Release Cap. NEW Patent Pending Pump Action Sleeve Offers Smoother Cut. Machined In Columbia's State Of The Art Factory In Canada. Measures 42" in Length Compared To 52" Of Full-Size Taper.

product_description: Columbia has answered the call from our customers looking for a lighter/more affordable version of the Tomahawk Smoothing Blades. The Sabre Smoothing Blades still offer a precise finish but by no means does this product replace the Tomahawk’s being our premium option. It is our solution to Columbia Customers looking for a lighter/more affordable option. The body profile remains the same as the Tomahawk’s but is made from high quality plastic rather than billet aluminum. One of the standout features of the Sabre Smoothing Blades is their remarkable weight—around 60% lighter than the Tomahawk Smoothing Blades—making them easier to maneuver and control. Additionally, they offer a competitive price point costing around 40% less allowing you to choose the right tool for your needs without compromise. Whether you prefer manual use or want to enhance your reach with a Sabre Extension pole (using the Sabre Claw adapter), the Sabre Smoothing Blades deliver perfectly even usage and smoothness across the entire length of the blade. Their ergonomic and lightweight design ensures that you can work efficiently without fatigue. FEATURES: 10 sizes: 7″, 10″, 12″, 14″, 16″, 18″, 24″, 32″, 40″ & 48″ Works with by hand or with the Sabre Claw Adapter (SBC) adaptor for the Sabre Pole (SBP) Hardened Stainless Steel Blade: Durable and ultra-abrasion resistant for long-lasting performance. Rounded Anti-Trace Edges: Designed to minimize marks and imperfections. High-Performance Bi-Flex Technology: Featuring a PVC plate for enhanced flexibility and control.

Stainless steel side plates and cable drum and creaser arms offer a lifetime of corrosion resistance. Every taper comes standard with an adjustable brake and quick release for tape changing. product_description_html:
Operation

The Mud Head is designed to place a consistently wide ribbon of joint compound to each side of the internal or external corner for installation of paper tape or corner bead. Snap the Mud Head onto the corner applicator or MudRunner® and fill it with joint compound. Start at one end of the corner and apply pressure to the corner applicator or MudRunner™ to start the flow of compound while moving the tool along the corner to the opposite end. Now apply the tape or corner bead.

 

Maintenance

Clean thoroughly with brush and water (or water hose) to remove all joint compound from the tool. After the tool is clean, lightly oil with Ames® Bazooka® Oil or any light machine oil.

product_description: The TapeTech EasyClean Finishing Box automatically dispenses the proper amount of joint compound and feathers the edges of butt joints and flat joints in one pass. The EasyClean Finishing Box helps produce professional results every time. The adjustable crown setting dial allows the user to easily adjust the amount of joint compound applied over the tape on the drywall joint. This is very helpful when progressing from the first finishing application to the second or third application. The pivoting axle helps to compensate when the drywall or sheetrock on one side of the joint is higher than the other side of the joint. The new EasyRoll wheel system allows you to expertly finish all types of outside corner bead up to two times faster than finishing by hand. EasyRoll wheels work with all types of outside corner bead including metal, paper-faced, vinyl and bullnose. EasyRoll wheels provide a shoulder to guide the finishing box along the corner bead without after-market attachments or damage to the axle. The shoulder of the EasyRoll wheels is more than three times wider than after-market products, making it easier to place, and keep, the finishing box on the corner bead. And EasyRoll wheels are engineered and designed to be perfectly aligned with the finishing blade, eliminating the need to tilt the finishing box like you must with common after-market wheel systems. EasyRoll wheels do not affect how the finishing box runs on standard flat joints. All TapeTech finishing boxes now feature EasyRoll wheels for finishing outside corner bead. product_description: Introducing the new Power Assist MAXXBOX finishing boxes from TapeTech . Now you can have the extra capacity you want with half the effort required from other high capacity finishing boxes. Featuring the same smart design that matches the usable capacity to the application, the Power Assist MAXXBOX is sure to become the industry standard for finishing! These boxes work with all TapeTech finishing handles, including the 8000TT-PA Wizard handle for Power Assist boxes. With a usable joint compound capacity that varies by less than 10% across the range, the TapeTech Power Assist finishing boxes hold the right amount of joint compound to keep you on the wall longer without wearing you out. The Power Assist series features TapeTech s famous EasyClean design. The adjustable crown setting dial allows the user to easily adjust the amount of joint compound applied over the tape on the drywall joint. This is very helpful when progressing from the first embedding application to the second or third finishing coat. The pivoting axle helps to compensate when the drywall or sheetrock on one side of the joint is higher than the other side of the joint. The new EasyRoll wheel system allows you to expertly finish all types of outside corner bead up to two times faster than finishing by hand. EasyRoll wheels work with all types of outside corner bead including metal, paper-faced, vinyl and bullnose. EasyRoll wheels provide a shoulder to guide the finishing box along the corner bead without after-market attachments or damage to the axle. The shoulder of the EasyRoll wheels is more than three times wider than after-market products, making it easier to place, and keep, the finishing box on the corner bead. And EasyRoll wheels are engineered and designed to be perfectly aligned with the finishing blade, eliminating the need to tilt the finishing box like you must with common after-market wheel systems. EasyRoll wheels do not affect how the finishing box runs on standard flat joints. All TapeTech finishing boxes now feature EasyRoll wheels for finishing outside corner bead. Applies first coat of joint compound to embed tape at butt joints and flat joints on walls and ceilings Finishes butt joints and flat joints on walls and ceilings Feathers edges of butt joints and flat joints EasyFinish bent handles help to activate the Power Assist mechanism

product_description: The new QuickBox QSX from TapeTech is the first finishing box specifically designed to be used with fast-setting joint compounds. The 6 QuickBox QSX is the perfect tool for contractors who use fast-setting joint compound for the first coat over the paper or fiberglass joint tape. Constructed from advanced space age materials, fast-setting joint compound is easily removed from the finishing box, even hours or days later. The compound literally falls out of the QuickBox QSX with a few light taps. The glass-filled polypropylene shell provides a slick surface with maximum strength and durability. The optimized blade design matches the blade with the application, eliminating the need to make adjustments or change crown settings. And it takes just a few seconds to change the long-lasting blades. QuickBox QSX works with all finishing box handles, including the Wizard . Now you can combine the speed and consistency of finishing boxes with the speed of fast-setting joint compound! Includes: (1) QuickBox QSX (1) QB60035 Blade (1) QB60235 Blade

product_description: TapeTech is the first company to introduce an interchangeable handle system that allows one support handle to be used with every tool. Whether you use standard, fixed length fiberglass handles or aluminum extension support handles, you’ll need just one base handle. The base handle for the fiberglass system is model FHTT. The base handle for the extension handle system is model XHTT. The base handle fits the corner roller, corner applicator and nail spotter without any adapters. The heavy duty, easy-to-change adapter (CFA-TT) connects the new handles to the corner finishers, and the new, optimal diameter makes TapeTech handles the most ergonomic in the industry. Both base handles feature a D-shaped fitting that securely positions the handle in the Corner Applicator and positively prevents the tool from rotating during use. Note: If you use your current Nail Spotters with the new handle system you will need to mount the handle in the back holes of the tabs on the Nail Spotter.

The Wizard is the only finishing box handle that places your hand directly over the pressure plate, reducing the effort required while providing superior control. Every drywall finisher needs the Wizard™ in their toolbox!
